title: Ankhorage AWS Infrastructure
summary: Records the repository boundary reserved for shared Amazon Web Services infrastructure.
purpose: Keep ownership of future AWS infrastructure artifacts separate from provider adapters and application repositories.
responsibilities: Own the repository-level boundary for shared AWS infrastructure artifacts when they are introduced.
boundaries: Does not currently contain deployable AWS configuration or automation.
Does not own provider-specific application adapters or application runtime behavior.
audience: Infrastructure maintainers evaluating or introducing shared AWS resources.

architecture.role: Non-source infrastructure repository with no deployed implementation on the current default branch.
invariants: Future shared infrastructure remains distinct from package-level provider adapter ownership.

limitations: The current default branch contains licensing and repository metadata only; it does not provision AWS resources.
